name: io.github.walkley/cn-calendar
title: China Workday Calendar
description: China workdays with official holidays and makeup days, plus package CVE checks. Free daily quota.

tools.name: cn_workday_check
tools.description: Is a date a working day in mainland China? Applies State Council (国务院) holiday notices: public holidays, weekend makeup workdays (调休补班) and ordinary weekends; returns the holiday name and the gov.cn source link. Pass date for one day, or from and to (inclusive, up to 366 days) to count and list working days; with no arguments it checks today (Asia/Shanghai). Coverage 2020-01-01..2027-12-31. Free for 20 calls per day, then pay-per-call over x402.

date.description: One date (YYYY-MM-DD). Do not combine with from/to. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai, when date, from and to are all omitted.

tools.name: package_advisories
tools.description: Is this package version safe to install? Dependency check for install safety before npm install, pip install or cargo add, for one exact npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven package version. Known OSV.dev advisories (CVE, GHSA, PYSEC, GO, RUSTSEC vulnerabilities and OpenSSF malicious-package MAL- entries) with CVSS, affected ranges, fixed versions and links. Free for 20 calls per day (shared with cn_workday_check), then pay-per-call over x402.

name.description: Package name exactly as published; matching is case-sensitive for npm (lodash, not Lodash; legacy names such as JSONStream keep their case). Maven uses groupId:artifactId, Go the module path. PyPI names are normalised.

tools.name: sec_insider_trades
tools.description: Recent insider trading for a US public company: SEC Form 4 filings parsed into structured JSON (insider name and role, transaction date and code, shares, price, shares owned after, Rule 10b5-1 flag, filing link), by stock ticker or SEC CIK. Pay-per-call over x402, no free calls: the tool validates the arguments and answers with a payment link to the paid URL GET /sec/insider-trades.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK-B. Pass ticker or cik, not both. Default: AAPL, when ticker and cik are both omitted.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros, e.g. 320193
